title: Strawberry Milkshake with Whipped Cream
summary: A thick strawberry milkshake made by puréeing the fruit first, then blending it briefly with vanilla ice cream, topped with whipped cream and a whole berry.

ingredients.item: frozen strawberries, thawed (or ripe fresh strawberries, hulled)
fine sea salt or table salt

steps.title: Prepare
steps.text: Put 2 tall glasses in the freezer and leave the ice cream on the counter for 10-15 minutes, until it is just scoopable.

steps.title: Whip
steps.text: Whisk the cream and sugar to soft peaks and keep it in the fridge.

steps.title: Purée
steps.text: Blend the thawed strawberries on their own for about a minute until completely smooth. Doing this first means no lumps of fruit are left.

steps.title: Blend
steps.text: Add the ice cream, milk and salt and blend just until smooth and thick, 20-30 s. Blending for longer warms and thins the shake.

steps.title: Top
steps.text: Pour into the cold glasses, spoon a cloud of whipped cream onto each and finish with a whole strawberry.

tips: Thawed frozen strawberries give a deeper pink and stronger flavour than out-of-season fresh berries.
For a thinner shake, add another 30 ml of milk.
Use squirty cream from a can if you are short of time.
storage: Serve immediately; milkshakes do not keep. Cool leftovers in a shallow container and refrigerate within 2 hours (within 1 hour on a day above 32°C).
